def is_delete_value(value):
    if value is None:

    if isinstance(value, str):

        return s == "" or s in {"0", "$", "$0", "$0.0"}

            "protection": copy(cell.protection),
            "comment": copy(cell.comment) if cell.comment else None,
            "hyperlink": copy(cell.hyperlink) if cell.hyperlink else None,
        })
    original_rows.append(row_cells)

# Keep rows unless both J and K meet the deletion criteria
kept_rows = []
for idx, row_cells in enumerate(original_rows, start=min_row):
    j_val = ws.cell(idx, col_j).value
    k_val = ws.cell(idx, col_k).value
    if not (is_delete_value(j_val) and is_delete_value(k_val)):
        kept_rows.append(row_cells)

# Rewrite kept rows at the top of the allowed range

    for offset, cell_info in enumerate(row_cells):
        c = min_col + offset
        cell = ws.cell(out_r, c)
        cell.value = cell_info["value"]
        cell._style = copy(cell_info["style"])
        cell.number_format = cell_info["number_format"]
        cell.font = copy(cell_info["font"])
        cell.fill = copy(cell_info["fill"])
        cell.border = copy(cell_info["border"])
        cell.alignment = copy(cell_info["alignment"])
        cell.protection = copy(cell_info["protection"])
        cell.comment = copy(cell_info["comment"]) if cell_info["comment"] else None
        cell._hyperlink = copy(cell_info["hyperlink"]) if cell_info["hyperlink"] else None

# Clear the remaining rows within the answer range
for r in range(min_row + len(kept_rows), max_row + 1):
    for c in range(min_col, max_col + 1):
        cell = ws.cell(r, c)
        cell.value = None
        cell.comment = None
